'''Space worms''' were gigantic creatures&mdash;capable of surviving in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]&mdash;which fed on minerals. They were responsible for hollowing out [[Eskaron]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], but due to this they exposed Eskaron's molten core, which expanded, destroyed the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] some of the worms. When the worms used up their food source, they moved on from the [[Star system/Legends|system]] millennia before it was discovered by [[Reidi Artom]].

The remnants of one worm was found in Eskaron and called simply [[the Worm]].
